title: [Bug] Claude Code: Persistent Instruction Disregard and Output Quality Degradation
body:
**Bug Description**
Something is not right. I have used Claude code for quite some time and I need you to know this is different in the latest updates of Claude Code. I can go to Cursor and it works fine but if I go to Claude code my quality decreases in output for one reason it literally ignores what I tell it. I will give it exact file paths and say it exists and say no this exists please stop trying to make files that exist and continue with the rest of the work like in this convo. then it will ignore my demands until I get very very aggressive and start cussing at it. I have to bully the model in Claude code into just listening to me sometimes resorting to threats. this is a common method I used in end of 2024. I saw that you guys found a known issue or a handful of them that caused output quality reduction. once you fixed this the day I upgraded to the latest claude code version this started to happen. I use Claude code alot and I would never come to you with this unless I was certain. Something is critically wrong with Claude code

**Environment Info**
- Platform: win32
- Terminal: windows-terminal
- Version: 1.0.120
- Feedback ID: fa462473-a581-4bb5-8cf1-fd8697143392

top_comments.body: this is tough to deal with and I am considering moving away from Claude Code until this has been resolved and this is really sad I will have to go to the Cursor Ultra package which gives me much less usage. Btw this is not happening with Claude Sonnet through Cursor which I will have to now use. I made a Bug the other day about quality of outputs also and have not gotten any replies. please help me here I am willing to collab or show you but this is bad enough that is it ongoing 3 days at least

top_comments.author: Ivor
top_comments.body: Same experience. Its been degrading a lot. To the point where I keep checking which model I am using. It doesn't use its agents, it doesn't read the instructions and it dreams up modules and functions that do not exist. It is difficult to not assume that intelligence is being throttled to be used for other purposes.
